About the job
Maintora helps machine builders and plant operators move from reactive to predictive maintenance. Our SaaS platform connects sensor data, service histories and spare parts in one place and tells service teams what will fail next. Founded in 2017 as a spin-off from a Munich university institute, we now have 240 employees, more than 600 customers in 19 countries and an annual recurring revenue of EUR 38 million. In 2025 we closed a EUR 60 million growth round led by a European software investor.

The DACH region is our home market and still accounts for 55 % of our revenue. Until now, Sales and Marketing have been run as two separate teams reporting to the CEO. We are bringing them together under one leader and are looking for our first Director Sales & Marketing DACH.

This is a permanent, full-time position reporting directly to our CEO, as a member of the extended leadership team.

What you will do
- Lead the DACH go-to-market organisation: 14 Account Executives, 6 Sales Development Representatives, 4 Key Account Managers for our 40 largest customers and a marketing team of 9 (demand generation, product marketing, events and content)
- Own the DACH revenue plan, including a new ARR target of EUR 11 million for 2027, and translate it into territory, capacity and hiring plans
- Build one integrated funnel from first touch to closed deal, with shared definitions, service level agreements between Marketing and Sales and a single pipeline review
- Develop our account-based marketing approach for large OEMs and plant operators together with the Key Account team
- Shape pricing and packaging for our new asset performance module together with Product Management and Finance
- Improve forecasting accuracy and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce, introduce a consistent qualification method (we currently pilot MEDDICC) and build dashboards the leadership team actually uses
- Expand our partner channel with system integrators and machine builders who resell Maintora under their own brand
- Hire, coach and develop team leads and create career paths for Account Executives and SDRs

What you bring
- 12+ years of B2B sales experience in software, industrial automation or industrial services, of which at least 6 years leading sales teams
- A proven track record of growing recurring revenue in a subscription or SaaS model
- Experience in leading marketing teams, or at least a very close partnership with marketing, including demand generation and ABM
- Strong commercial judgement on pricing, discounting and deal structuring for mid-market and enterprise customers
- Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot or comparable CRM and marketing automation tools
- A leadership style that combines clear targets with genuine care for people
- Native-level German and fluent English; the role involves regular customer meetings in Germany, Austria and Switzerland

What we offer
- Base salary of EUR 150,000 to 170,000 plus a variable component of 35 % at target, paid quarterly
- Participation in our virtual stock option programme
- Hybrid work: 2 days per week in our office in Unterföhring, 3 days remote, plus up to 20 working days per year from other EU countries
- 30 days of vacation, plus 24 and 31 December off
- Company car (also for private use) or a mobility budget of EUR 700 per month
- Company pension scheme with a 30 % employer contribution
- Annual learning budget of EUR 3,000 and an executive coaching programme
- A modern office with good S-Bahn connections, dog-friendly floors and a team that likes to celebrate wins

About the process
Our process consists of an introductory call with our Talent Partner, a conversation with our CEO, a case study on the 2027 go-to-market plan that you present to the CEO, the CFO and the VP Product, and a final meeting with two members of your future team. We aim to make an offer within four weeks.

Please note that this is a permanent employment position (unbefristet). We are not able to consider interim, freelance or project-based engagements for this role, and we do not work with recruitment agencies on this search.

Maintora is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all people, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age or sexual identity. If you need any adjustments during the application process, just let us know.
